how_to_run: Build a catalog of every installed skill's name + description (this kit's skills plus the externals/companions a workspace normally has), mix all eval queries into one numbered list, and have 3 independent judges route each query using ONLY the catalog — no repo access. Majority vote per query. Pass = trigger queries route here; no-trigger queries route anywhere else ('route' names the expected sibling, diagnostic only). In this repo, tools/trigger-evals/ holds the checked-in harness.

queries.q: We have an incident — checkout is failing for everyone
The site is down, help me figure out why
Triage this alert: p95 latency on /api/orders jumped to 8s
Error rate spiked at 14:00, here are the logs — what's going on?
Outage on staging since the last deploy — investigate and propose mitigations
The pager went off for a queue backlog; triage it
Users report 502s since this morning, here's the Datadog screenshot
Help me run this incident: timeline, likely causes, mitigations
Fix this on staging — login is broken there
This test fails intermittently, debug it
Check the production logs for errors
Investigate how the invite-user workflow works

last_run.method: 3 independent fresh catalog-only judges over the full 450-query mixed set, deterministic shuffle; each judge had a private folder with its own copy of the judge prompt, catalog, and query list and was instructed to read nothing else, with no repository access (instruction-level isolation, not a sandbox; transcripts checked to reference only their own folder).
last_run.result: 450/450 pass — majority vote passed every query; 443 unanimous, 7 passed 2/3.
last_run.judge_model: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 3 independent Claude Code Agent-tool subagents
